title: DARKER THAN BLACK: Kuro no Keiyakusha - Gaiden
justification: AniList 7338 (SPECIAL, 4 episode(s) from 2010-01-27 to 2010-07-21) is AniDB 6644's special(s) S1-S4 'Gaiden OVA 1' to 'Gaiden OVA 4', aired 2010-01-27, 2010-03-24, 2010-05-26 and 2010-07-21, and AniDB lists MAL 7338 on AniDB 6644. The parent's mapping rows place them on TVDB 80042 0x2-0x5 'Gaiden Part 1' to 'Gaiden Part 4', on the same four dates.
